title: Define debian manifest section contract
summary: Extend the package-manager manifest contract with a debian-specific manifest section (control file metadata, postinst/prerm placeholders, file ownership, systemd service placeholder, dependency declaration) following the homebrew section pattern, with empty placeholders and a validator hook. Publication and signing remain human-owned.
expectedFailureModes: Debian manifest section ships without a schema validator and drifts into machine-local install paths.
docs/status.md overclaims debian package availability before repository custody is decided.
Validator hook is added but not wired into validate.sh --scripts, so regressions slip past CI.
humanEscalation: Debian repository hosting, signing keys, and uploads remain human-owned.
nextAction: Add a debian section to the package-manager manifest schema with required fields (control metadata, depends, postinst, prerm, service unit, file ownership), emit empty placeholders, register a validator hook, and document the contract in docs/distribution-readiness.md without claiming debian packages ship.
